name: formify
description: Build fillable PDF forms and contracts, send them for e-signature, verify signers with BankID or an ID scan, and track what happens after sending.

interface.longDescription: Formify turns an assistant into someone who can prepare a contract, place the signature fields correctly, send it for electronic signature, and verify the person on the other end with BankID, an ID document scan, a live face check or a company lookup. Building the document is free and works without an account; sending and signing use your Formify account.
defaultPrompt: Turn this PDF into a fillable form
